subtitle: Most operators missed every single one. Here is the signal log.
author: April 21–25, 2026

strategies.label: BREAK 1
strategies.title: GPT-5.5 ships as the first agent base model
strategies.body: OpenAI markets it as an agent, not a chat model. API price doubled to $5 / $30 per MTok.
strategies.takeaway: Your AI outbound unit economics reset this week.

strategies.label: BREAK 2
strategies.title: Clay MCP went live in Claude + ChatGPT
strategies.body: Run any saved Clay workflow from chat. No app switch — the data layer is in the assistant.
strategies.takeaway: The interface is collapsing. The tool is the prompt.

strategies.label: BREAK 3
strategies.title: OpenAI Workspace Agents launched at $20 / seat
strategies.body: Native Salesforce, Slack, and Notion plug-ins. Free until May 6 — then per-seat pricing.
strategies.takeaway: Microsoft Copilot finally has a same-priced rival.

strategies.label: BREAK 4
strategies.title: HubSpot Prospecting Agent auto-sources contacts
strategies.body: It now pulls leads from ZoomInfo, Apollo, and Surfe automatically. 28 days free for eligible accounts.
strategies.takeaway: Native CRM sourcing is now table stakes.

strategies.label: BREAK 5
strategies.title: Clay replaced by $200 of Claude Code
strategies.body: Adam Robinson published Taylor Haren's case study — Clay swapped for a Claude Code pipeline. Claim: 272k leads/sec.
strategies.takeaway: Bespoke pipelines are eating per-seat pricing.

strategies.label: BREAK 6
strategies.title: Clay went down for multiple days on April 23
strategies.body: A multi-day enrichment outage hit the same week the Robinson case study landed.
strategies.takeaway: Vendor concentration is the silent risk.

strategies.label: BREAK 7
strategies.title: Browser tools restrict 4× less than cloud tools
strategies.body: OutX studied 12k LinkedIn users across 47 outbound tools. Browser: 8% restriction. Cloud: 31%.
strategies.takeaway: Architecture is the new compliance moat.

strategies.label: BREAK 8
strategies.title: $10.5M into bottom-of-funnel agents
strategies.body: Realm raised $4.5M from HubSpot Ventures. DOJO AI closed $6M at a $30M valuation.
strategies.takeaway: The money is moving downstream of the SDR.

strategies.label: BREAK 9
strategies.title: Microsoft pushed SMTP Basic Auth to Dec 2026
strategies.body: Original cutoff was April 30. Eight extra months for legacy senders to migrate to OAuth.
strategies.takeaway: Reprieve, not amnesty. Treat Dec 2026 as already gone.

cta_repost.headline: Which of these breaks your stack first?
cta_repost.sub: Reply with the number — I'll send back what I'd swap, kill, or double down on.
